C calloc returns null or an initialized nonaliasing allocation of the requested size
C malloc returns null or a fresh nonaliasing allocation of the requested size; bytes are initialized before read or remain unobserved
C free accepts a live allocation from calloc or malloc, or null
abort terminates execution; no cleanup after traps is promised
native compiler, linker, loader, libc and host hardware are trusted

protocol.cold_build_admission: publication gate uses installed-bridge warm cost; cold cost is additionally reported, including losses; warm admission is not a claim of cold-deployment gain
protocol.control: fixed_selected minimizes summed training upper costs across all profiles; light minimizes current-profile upper cost
protocol.cost_exclusions: already installed Python/Z3/Clang/Rust and dependency download/cache creation; experiment source authoring, prior development attempts and final evidence serialization are not deployment work
protocol.costs: episode wall through runtime cleanup plus measured shared setup; NDU additionally reports fresh cold bridge build amortized over its frozen episodes
protocol.descriptive_increment_rule: saving must exceed the threshold versus every control and have positive median saving in every profile; no statistical inference
protocol.direct_deployment_control: fixed_stop observed episode wall without shared corpus charge; same native baseline preparation, input checks, holdout calls and cleanup
protocol.failures: retain every attempted row; no retries, sample dropping or parameter tuning after freeze
protocol.order: rotating order, reversed on odd rounds; profiles rotate with repetition
protocol.primary_metric: paired cold-amortized full-cost saving of NDU versus every declared fixed control and light; median over six matched profile/repetition pairs
protocol.publication: fresh all-input proof, real native build/probe, generation-and-epoch compare-and-swap, actual preparation budget
protocol.shared_cost_denominator: full shared work is conservatively charged once per standalone arm episode (denominator 1); it physically executes once per campaign
protocol.shared_training: all arms receive and pay the same full observed candidate/proof/build/training corpus per episode
protocol.uncertainty: ceil(max absolute batch deviation from median / calls), minimum 1 ns; not a confidence interval
